signature.name: VTask.comp
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> {γ : Type u_3} -> [PseudoEMetricSpace α] -> [PseudoEMetricSpace β] -> [PseudoEMetricSpace γ] -> (g : β →ᵈ γ) -> (f : α →ᵈ β) -> α →ᵈ γ

conventions.statement: The ratio of VTask.comp g f equals ratio g * ratio f.
conventions.note: Follows from the multiplicativity of the scaling factors under composition.

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Type*} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] [PseudoEMetricSpace γ] (g : β →ᵈ γ) (f : α →ᵈ β), Dilation.ratio (VTask.comp g f) = Dilation.ratio g * Dilation.ratio f

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Type*} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] [PseudoEMetricSpace γ] (g : β →ᵈ γ) (f : α →ᵈ β), Dilation.ratio (VTask.comp g f) ≠ 0

facts.statement: ∀ {α β γ : Type*} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [PseudoEMetricSpace β] [PseudoEMetricSpace γ] (g : β →ᵈ γ) (f : α →ᵈ β), Dilation.ratio (VTask.comp g f) = Dilation.ratio f * Dilation.ratio g
